etsy.title: sudo Poster, sudo !! Terminal Humor Print, Sysadmin Gift, Command Line Wall Art for Tech Office
etsy.description:
A funny sudo poster for every command you forgot to run as root, rerun with sudo !!, in dark-mode colors.

WHAT YOU'LL GET
• A physical poster print, shipped directly to you
• Available in 8×10 in or 11×17 in
• Printed on premium matte paper at 300 DPI

HOW TO USE
Frame and hang for a home office, dev den, or coding setup.

This listing is a physical poster print. Thank you for supporting a small shop!

competitorNotes: Sudo humor on Etsy is mostly 'sudo make me a sandwich' terminal mockups and 'root access dad' prints; 'sudo !!' itself did not appear as a poster.
Linux/terminal poster results are dominated by command cheat sheets, often digital downloads.
Printed sudo and Linux joke posters were shown at roughly $15 to $38; digital versions $1 to $7.
Amazon's terminal-themed wall art is almost all command cheat-sheet canvases (8x12 to 16x24, unframed) and tin signs, not jokes.

research.notes: Listing pages were not fetched (network allow-list); evidence is from Etsy/Amazon search results only. 'linux poster' has the strongest Etsy evidence, but Linux is not printed on the poster, so it is kept out of the title and tags; 'sudo' is indexed by Etsy (sudo tshirt, sudo make me a sandwich). priceRange is from search snippets for printed sudo/Linux posters.
